title: Figure 11: Radio Reflection Detector for Over-the-Horizon Detection of Hypersonic Aircraft
description: Schematic of the curved Earth with a 'Radio Transmitter' sending rays upward and a 'Radio Receiver' beyond its line of sight. A 'Hypersonic Aircraft' with an ionized wake reflects energy to the receiver; an annotation reads 'The radio receiver is not in line-of-sight with the transmitter, yet receives reflected energy from the transmitter by the aircraft.'
